purpose: Teach: 非課税/管区/掌握/発現/短調/寛大/トップクラス/発効

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、非課税枠を活用して投資された
lines.en: When we started, Father was brilliant at using tax-exempt investment frameworks.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Gentle reverence in the voice. Pause before each detail, as if drawing from deep memory. Quiet admiration underneath — not performing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは販売管区を整備された
lines.en: Yes. Father had the foresight to establish our regional sales infrastructure.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. A son honoring his father's decisions with precision. Even pace, steady eye-contact in the voice. Not reciting — affirming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、市場掌握の手腕がお見事だった
lines.en: Father's instinct for reading the market — it was remarkable.
lines.style: Softer now, with a slight distance. Wistful but grounded. Small pause before 'remarkable,' like he's still struck by it. The voice of someone watching a memory pass.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品効果の発現を辛抱強く待たれた
lines.en: Yes. He had the patience to let products find their moment. He didn't rush.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Reflective tone — not celebrating, just observing the weight of that discipline. Slow enough to let each phrase land. Slight exhale after 'didn't rush.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員に短調の悲観論を許されなかった
lines.en: Father never allowed pessimism among the staff. He wouldn't tolerate it.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Quiet conviction underneath. Not harsh — respectful of his resolve. A small emphasis on the refusal, like Father's backbone was visible in that choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に寛大だった
lines.en: Yes. But he was generous with them. Never harsh.
lines.style: Quick, warm correction. The son stepping in to complete the portrait — showing the other side of the firmness. Gentle but clear. A small, knowing tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、トップクラスの経営者と評価されてた
lines.en: He was recognized as one of the finest managers of his generation.
lines.style: Drawn out, almost weightless. The voice of someone stating a fact they've carried for a long time. Wistful distance. Quiet pride underneath, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新法の発効を見据えて準備された
lines.en: Yes. He was already preparing for the new regulations before anyone else saw them coming.
lines.style: Closing reflection. Steady, grounded, with a note of quiet wisdom. Not triumphant — just factual. The voice of someone who finally understands his father's foresight. Slight warmth at the end, like a small benediction.
